jobs.title: Director, Corporate Strategy
jobs.description:
About the role

We are hiring for a Director, Strategy and Growth Initiatives to help define and drive the long-term strategy and growth of the company. As our Director, you’ll identify where the business should go next, shape the long-term vision with senior leadership, and turn that into actionable initiatives that drive durable growth. You’ll work across Product, Marketing, Analytics, and other functions to solve the company’s most important and ambiguous problems, and ensure those strategies translate into real outcomes.

In this role, you can expect to

- Identify and lead high-impact strategic initiatives that drive long-term growth and business durability

- Analyze market, competitor, and consumer trends to inform company strategy and priorities

- Partner closely with senior leaders to shape long-term vision and drive alignment across the organization

- Translate strategy into actionable plans and ensure initiatives are executed across cross-functional teams

- Develop deep analytical insights and research to support decision-making and prioritization

- Influence decisions and drive accountability across Product, Marketing, Analytics, and other functions

- Lead complex problem-solving efforts and guide project teams to deliver measurable business outcomes

To thrive in this role, you have

- 10+ years of experience in strategy/management consulting, corporate strategy, or operating roles within financial services or fintech

- An MBA or equivalent experience

- Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment across complex organizationsx

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including financial modeling and data-driven decision making

- Experience leading and managing project teams and driving initiatives end-to-end

- Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate insights into clear recommendations

- Deep experience in fintech/financial services and/or hands-on experience with data analysis, market research, or product analytics (preferred)

jobs.title: Senior Associate, Strategic Finance
jobs.description:
About the role

We’re seeking a Strategic Finance Senior Associate to join the Finance team at Chime. As a finance team member, you will have a key role in collaborating with the Strategic Finance team to shape our business and financial strategy, while completing numerous high-impact initiatives at the company. You will help us build unit economic frameworks to better understand our business model to drive continuous improvement of KPIs, while collaborating with cross-functional business partners to evaluate the ROI of products, features, and initiatives. We are looking for an analytical problem-solver with a strategic mindset - someone who can do more than just crunch numbers! A key part of this role is the ability to understand the details while keeping sight of the broader strategy. This is a high-visibility role on a tight knit team. You will work day to day with Product, Analytics, Risk, Growth, Accounting, and Corporate Finance. The StratFin team routinely interacts with senior executives and cross-functional partnership is an everyday occurrence, so effective communication skills are a must!

In this role, you can expect to

- Support the development of unit economic frameworks to evaluate the ROI of various products, features, and business strategies and guide Chime’s decision-making

- Evaluate economic viability and drive strategy for Chime’s new and emerging products

- Build strong working relationships with cross-functional teams including Product, Risk, Analytics, and Marketing to strategically advise on financial impact and improve business performance

- Use tools such as Pigment to manage and own financial forecasts and advise executive leadership on business unit and product performance on a regular basis

- Contribute to board/investor materials, public facing materials & disclosures, and other external reporting to advise investors and other key partners on overall company financial health and product positioning & performance

- Guide and partner closely with our Analytics team to create dashboards and KPIs to track product health, as well as evaluate experimental results

- Champion the adoption of AI and automation across the forecast process, compressing close-to-forecast turnaround, standardizing recurring reporting, and reducing manual effort in Pigment and Sheets

To thrive in this role, you have

- Minimum 4-7 years of relevant experience in strategic finance, FP&A, investment banking, consulting, or business intelligence; prior experience at a high-growth technology or financial technology company a plus

- Bachelor’s Degree, or equivalent degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Accounting or other relevant field

- Demonstrated experience building driver-based forecasts (e.g., volume × rate, unit economics, cohort models) with a clear point of view on how you validate drivers and diagnose forecast vs. actual variance

- Expertise in Excel / Google Sheets — you can build scalable, efficient, and auditable models with clear assumptions, and you have opinions about how a model should be structured

- Superior communication skills and the ability to collaborate with all levels of an organization — you can take a complex, multi-driver result and give a non-finance partner the answer first, then the logic

- A strong sense of ownership and comfort with ambiguity

- Strong process-improvement mindset with demonstrated ability to leverage AI and automation to scale finance workflows and improve forecasting precision and turnaround time

- A team-oriented mindset and a positive attitude

- Bonus Experience: payments, banking, or money-movement economics; cohort analysis; Pigment, NetSuite, Looker, Snowflake

jobs.title: Senior Incident Operations Manager
jobs.location: Chicago, IL, USA; New York, NY, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA
jobs.description:
About this role

At Chime, we help our members achieve financial peace of mind. To do this we need features that are highly available and human & technical systems that are resilient. That’s where you come in. You will be a member of our Incident Response team to help Chime improve our readiness, response and drive organizational change from incidents.

As an Incident Operations Manager on Chime's Incident Operations team (Platform Engineering), you'll manage incidents end to end: from declaration and coordination, through member communication and member remediation, to review and follow-through. You'll work across Engineering, Product, Member Experience (MX), Core Experience, Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Finance, and lead through influence rather than authority. You'll bring a proactive, solution-oriented mindset and keep the member at the center of every decision. Alongside on-call work, you'll own defined improvement workstreams that make our response better every quarter.

In this role, you can expect to:

- Coordinate incidents end to end. Serve on the incident on-call rotation, including some after-hours coverage on weekends, nights, and holidays. Independently run incidents from declaration to resolution: setting severity, paging the right responders, running the bridge, confirming member impact, and driving mitigation decisions.

- Help drive communication during incidents. Draft clear, accurate member messages across in-app, push, inbox, email, and support channels; move them through Compliance and Legal approval within severity-based timelines; and keep Support and MX teams equipped with talking points.

- Drive member remediation to closure . Run the Remediating phase: define workstreams, DRIs, and exit criteria; partner with Data to size the impacted population; coordinate credits and bulk adjustments with Finance, Compliance, and Core Experience

- Keep stakeholders informed. Deliver timely status reports and sitreps for leadership, and supply impact summaries and timelines that Compliance and Legal use for bank partner and regulatory notifications.

- Close the loop . Facilitate incident reviews for the incidents you manage, capture learnings, and make sure corrective actions have owners and due dates.

- Get ahead of problems . Spot risks and gaps before they become incidents or repeat incidents, raise them early, and come up with a proposed solution.

- Improve how we respond . Own at least one program workstream, such as pre-approved member message templates, runbooks, or response metrics, and ship measurable improvements.

- Cross-train and share knowledge. Build working fluency on both the technical-command and member-impact sides of an incident, and help train coordinators and responders.

To thrive in this role, you have

- 3+ years in incident management, or a similar operational role, including hands-on coordination of live, customer-impacting incidents.

- A strong member focus. You think first about how an incident affects real people and their money, and you measure success by whether members are informed and made whole, not just whether systems are restored.

- A proactive, solution-oriented approach. You act before being asked, look for the next risk instead of waiting for it, and bring options and recommendations.

- Experience managing the customer side of an incident: writing customer-facing communications, working with support teams, and coordinating remediation.

- Calm, structured judgment under pressure; you know when to decide, when to escalate, and when to ask for help.

- Enough technical fluency to follow engineers through an investigation and ask good questions (observability, deploys, dependencies, distributed systems).

- Experience with incident and observability tools such as PagerDuty, incident.io, Datadog, Slack-based incident tooling, Jira, and Google Workspace.

- Clear, concise writing for different audiences: members, technical SMEs, compliance partners, and executives.

- Strong follow-through; you drive action items and remediation work to closure without being chased.

Nice to have

- Experience in fintech, banking, payments, or another regulated industry.

jobs.title: Director of Growth and Acquisition Marketing
jobs.description:
About the role

Chime is on a mission to help millions of everyday people achieve financial progress — and we've built one of the strongest digital acquisition organizations in the industry to get there.

The Director of Growth and Acquisition owns what comes next: leading the full digital acquisition portfolio — paid social, paid search, affiliate, YouTube, mobile and app networks, and emerging channels — while building the capabilities that define Chime's next chapter of growth.

This is a leadership role, not a channel-management role. The foundation — building great teams, running healthy channels, and consistently delivering results — doesn't change. What changes is the mandate: this leader is accountable for delivering today's business while identifying and building tomorrow's growth engine, staying close enough to the ecosystem of platforms, agencies, and technology partners to bring new capabilities into Chime before they become table stakes.

This role sits within Chime's newly evolved Media & Acquisition organization, alongside a Director of Media leading Offline, Media Planning, and MMM. Together, these two roles are being broadened in scope as Chime moves from a channel-by-channel model toward a more complete, portfolio-level view of how every marketing dollar creates value.

In this role, you can expect to

- Own performance across Chime's full digital acquisition portfolio (paid social, paid search, affiliate, YouTube, mobile/app networks, and emerging channels), delivering ambitious growth, efficiency, and CAC targets.

- Make portfolio-level investment and prioritization calls across channels, talent, technology, and vendor partnerships, balancing near-term performance against long-term capability building.

- Lead and develop a team of experienced channel managers as a true player-coach — close enough to the work to challenge assumptions and unblock hard problems, but focused on multiplying impact through people and systems.

- Build new acquisition channels, partnerships, or technology-enabled growth motions — not just optimize the existing mix.

- Stay plugged into the external digital ecosystem — platforms, agencies, AI/martech vendors, startups — to identify opportunities before they're obvious and bring new capability into Chime early.

- Push the organization to rebuild how it works around AI: experimentation, creative production, media buying, and measurement — not just point-solution automation.

- Partner cross-functionally with Media Planning/MMM, Growth Product Marketing, Analytics, Risk, and Finance to align channel strategy to company-level growth and CAC goals.

- Represent Digital Acquisition in senior leadership forums, translating channel performance into business outcomes for Growth LT, EC, and Board-level audiences.

To thrive in this role, you have

- Experience leading a multi-channel digital acquisition or growth organization with meaningful business accountability — not only channel-level metrics.

- A demonstrated record of owning growth, efficiency, and business outcomes.

- Experience managing a significant media portfolio and making prioritization tradeoffs across channels, technology, and vendors.

- A leadership style that blends strategic range with hands-on credibility — comfortable operating as both strategist and player-coach.

- Experience building or scaling teams and developing future leaders.

- Comfort operating in a fast-moving, cross-functional, senior-executive-visible environment.

jobs.title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About the role

We're hiring a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to join our Product and Lifecycle Marketing team. In this role, you'll design and optimize lifecycle programs that engage, retain, and grow members across their entire journey with Chime—from top of funnel through long-term retention—with a clear focus on driving growth, revenue, and member lifetime value (LTV).

This is a role for a holistic, business-minded marketer rather than a single-channel specialist. You'll think in terms of segments, experiments, and outcomes: building targeted campaigns across the channels we own—push, in-app, and out-of-app (email, SMS)—while connecting those touchpoints with the broader, non-owned channels that shape the member experience. You'll partner closely with cross-functional teams to turn data into segmentation, automation, and personalization strategies that move the business.

This is a role with department-level impact: you'll own diverse projects, exercise significant independent judgment, and influence how members experience Chime across the full lifecycle.

If you're creative, dedicated, and love working in a fast-paced environment alongside passionate colleagues, we want to meet you.

In this role, you can expect to

- Own full-funnel lifecycle strategy—from top of funnel through activation and long-term retention—building targeted campaigns that drive growth, revenue, and member LTV.

- Define segments and translate them into targeted, personalized campaigns across owned channels (push, in-app, and out-of-app), connecting them with the broader non-owned channels that shape the end-to-end member experience.

- Generate data-driven hypotheses and run experiments to continuously optimize evergreen lifecycle campaigns and transactional communications, working with analytics to measure impact, socialize findings, and develop next steps toward bigger wins.

- Develop and steward channel guidelines and governance, preserving the quality and integrity of our communications ecosystem.

- Collaborate and build strong relationships with partners across Product, Product Marketing, Engineering, Analytics, Design, User Research, CRM, and more to develop and deliver on shared strategies for large cross-functional initiatives.

To thrive in this role, you have

- 4–6+ years of experience in lifecycle, growth, or related marketing, developing end-to-end campaigns from conceptualization to measurement.

- A growth-oriented, business-first mindset—you think about revenue, LTV, and the full funnel, not just individual channels, and you can connect owned channels (push, in-app, out-of-app) with the broader member experience.

- A proven track record of building segments and managing successful campaigns across multiple channels (email, push, SMS, in-app messaging).

- Strong experimentation chops—comfortable with A/B testing and using results to inform what to scale next.

- Strong analytical skills with experience in data-driven marketing and performance analysis.

- The ability to work cross-functionally and collaborate with various stakeholders, exercising significant independent judgment.

- Experience with key marketing platforms (Braze, Looker; AI tools a plus).

- A strong self-starter mindset—adaptable and able to think critically to develop creative solutions with limited resources.

jobs.title: Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About the role

We’re hiring a Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager to join our Lifecycle & CRM Marketing team and shape how Chime engages, retains, and grows members throughout their lifecycle. You’ll own the strategy behind complex, high-impact programs across email, push, in-app, and SMS, connecting member experiences to outcomes such as primacy, retention, product attach, ARPAM, and LTV. You’ll operate with a high degree of independence, lead through ambiguity, and know when to escalate while influencing decisions across Product, Growth, Product Marketing, Creative, Data Science, and Analytics. You’ll also help the Lifecycle team develop stronger ways of working and contribute to lifecycle innovation through data, AI, automation, and personalized cross-channel journeys.

In this role, you can expect to

- Own the lifecycle strategy for a complex, high-impact area of the business, setting a clear direction tied to member and business outcomes.

- Design and evolve connected member journeys across email, push, in-app, and SMS as member behavior, business priorities, and available data change.

- Develop segmentation and targeting strategies with Data Science to deliver more personalized, behavior-based programs.

- Set the testing agenda, identify the most valuable questions to answer, run rigorous experiments, and translate findings into strategy.

- Lead cross-functional decisions with Product, Growth, Product Marketing, Creative, Data Science, and Analytics, influencing lifecycle processes and capabilities beyond your immediate work.

- Use AI tools and automation as a core part of how you work, helping the team move toward more automated and personalized member journeys.

- Own the outcomes for your area, connecting lifecycle work to primacy, retention, product attach, ARPAM, and LTV while raising the quality of strategy and execution around you.

To thrive in this role, you have

- 6–8+ years of experience in lifecycle, integrated, or retention marketing, including leading complex, cross-functional programs that delivered measurable results.

- Strong data fluency and experience using analytics and AI-enabled tools such as Hex, Looker, or Statsig to answer questions, develop strategy, and recognize when further investigation is needed.

- Experience incorporating AI and automation into your day-to-day work, along with a clear point of view on how lifecycle marketing is evolving.

- Strong strategic judgment across member journeys, segmentation, targeting, channel orchestration, and testing.

- The ability to lead cross-functional conversations, influence senior partners, navigate ambiguity, operate independently, and recognize when escalation is appropriate.

- Deep member obsession and the judgment to balance member experience with business needs in high-stakes decisions.

- It’s a plus if you have hands-on experience with a CRM or marketing automation platform such as Braze, Iterable, or Klaviyo; have owned a lifecycle domain such as activation, retention, or monetization end to end; or have designed automation- or agent-driven journeys.

jobs.title: Senior Partner Manager
jobs.description:
About the role

We are hiring a Senior Partner Manager on the Partner Strategy and Operations team to help strengthen partner-delivered operations across our global support ecosystem. Our partners deliver much of what members experience when they need help, so this role goes beyond managing vendors: you will own the health, evolution, and strategic value of the member operations ecosystem, governing performance, challenging constraints, and translating frontline insights into organizational decisions.

To be effective, you will be one part Operator, running complex outsourced member operations with rigor; one part Strategist, treating today's operating model as a choice, not a given, and redesigning it to be meaningfully better; and one part Influencer, turning what the frontline sees into decisions the company makes. You will bring a point of view, not just a status update, to leaders across Chime.

The base salary offered for this role and level of experience will begin at $130,000 and up to $180,000. Full-time employees are also eligible for a bonus, competitive equity package, and benefits. The actual base salary offered may be higher, depending on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

In this role, you can expect to

Run the business (Operator)

- Own performance governance for assigned Partner/BPO operations, including SLAs, quality, productivity, staffing adherence, operational efficiency, and member experience outcomes.

- Lead daily, weekly, and monthly partner performance reviews with clear metrics, action plans, owners, timelines, and expected business impact.

- Drive accountability with external partners by identifying performance gaps, aligning on corrective actions, managing escalations, and ensuring sustained follow-through.

Improve the business (Strategist)

- Challenge the current operating model by asking how it could be 50% better, and identify opportunities across process redesign, automation and AI integration, channel optimization, and workforce and site strategy.

- Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives from problem definition and stakeholder alignment through execution, change management, and post-launch measurement, with clear business cases that weigh cost, risk, and member impact.

- Evaluate how AI and automation perform within partner operations, spotting failures in machine-led interactions and evolving oversight as the remaining human work becomes more complex.

- Develop partners into operating peers who bring ideas, flag risks early, and challenge decisions before they become problems.

Inform the business (Influencer)

- Spot emerging trends (i.e. defects, fraud patterns, confusing policies or metrics, product gaps) and translate them into root-cause insights, risk assessments, and data-backed recommendations.

- Partner closely with internal Member Experience teams (i.e. Customer Experience, Disputes Experience, Account Protection, Fraud and more), Workforce Management, Quality, Compliance, Product, Finance, Procurement, and Operations Strategy to remove blockers and shape product, policy, and experience decisions.

- Develop concise, executive-ready narratives that connect frontline performance, member impact, risks, and tradeoffs to a clear recommendation and decision.

To thrive in this role, you have

- 5+ years of experience in Customer Experience, Partner/Vendor Management, Program Management, BPO operations, or a related operational leadership role.

- Professional experience directly related to BPO partner and/or program management, ideally within financial services or another highly regulated environment.

- Executive presence and sound business judgment, comfortable building trust and influencing decisions, including with senior stakeholders, with a strong sense of ownership and comfort operating autonomously in ambiguity.

- Strong analytical skills, demonstrated ability to identify trends, diagnose root causes, assess risks, and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations that drive partner performance.

- Demonstrated ability to challenge the status quo, a track record of redesigning a process, system, or operating model, paired with the influence, relationship-building, and communication skills to drive alignment and accountability without direct authority.

- Curiosity about how AI and automation are reshaping frontline work, and experience evaluating or deploying them in an operations environment is a plus.

- Sound business judgment, high ownership, comfort operating autonomously in ambiguity, and willingness to travel domestically and internationally approximately 25% of the time.

- Proficiency with tools such as Excel, Google Sheets, Looker, Google Slides, Jira, or similar reporting, presentation, and project-management tools.

- Experience in Customer Support, Account Access and Identity, Risk, Complaints, Disputes, Escalations, Social Media support, or other specialized servicing environments is highly desired.
